in.other_title: Can debate extract inductive or tacit knowledge that lacks short, citeable justifications?
in.rationale: Saunders et al. state critique-based assistance does not address problems a model cannot put into words and that the critique-discrimination gap may stay large. Michael et al. ask whether debate can extract inductive or tacit knowledge lacking short citeable justifications, noting debaters revealed only about 3.5% of the story on average; one concerns critiques of summaries, the other debate on reading comprehension.
in.scope: proposed SAME_QUESTION_DIFFERENT_SETTING: whether oversight methods can surface model knowledge that the model cannot express as short, checkable statements
